ValidationRule.description: Employees must be 16+ at hire, hire date cannot be in the future by more than 90 days, interns under 26, and hire must not fall on 29 Feb for a non-leap check.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Hire_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Birthdate__c)), OR( ADDMONTHS(Birthdate__c, 192) > Hire_Date__c, Hire_Date__c > TODAY() + 90, AND(ISPICKVAL(Employment_Type__c, 'Intern'), ADDMONTHS(Birthdate__c, 312) < Hire_Date__c), AND(MONTH(Birthdate__c) = 2, DAY(Birthdate__c) = 29, MOD(YEAR(Birthdate__c), 4) <> 0) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Hire date and birthdate give an invalid age at hire.
